title: kruzovic7/ai-data-extractor
why_read: A utility for extracting chat histories from popular AI coding assistants is a practical tool for engineers who want to analyze or migrate their AI-assisted coding sessions.
analysis: This tool extracts conversation histories from tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Aider, and Cline/Roo Code, likely normalizing different storage formats into something more portable or analyzable. It's a useful utility for engineers who want to audit, back up, or study their own AI-assisted coding sessions across multiple tools. The value is practical rather than deeply technical, but the interoperability angle across several popular AI coding tools is a genuine convenience.
